def test_r6_archived_content_matches_original(tmp_path):
    _make_files(tmp_path, ["data.txt"], content=b"hello-archive-content")
    result = task_func(os.path.join(str(tmp_path), "*.txt"))
    if zipfile.is_zipfile(result):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(result) as zf:
            names = [n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith("data.txt")]
            assert names
            assert zf.read(names[0]) == b"hello-archive-content"
    else:
        with tarfile.open(result) as tf:
            members = [m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.name.endswith("data.txt")]
            assert members
            extracted = tf.extractfile(members[0]).read()
            assert extracted == b"hello-archive-content"

def test_r7_archive_content_preserved(tmp_path):
    _make_files(str(tmp_path), ["a.txt"], content="hello archive")
    result = task_func(os.path.join(str(tmp_path), "*.txt"))
    if zipfile.is_zipfile(result):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(result) as zf:
            name = [n for n in zf.namelist() if os.path.basename(n) == "a.txt"][0]
            data = zf.read(name).decode()
    else:
        with tarfile.open(result) as tf:
            member = [m for m in tf.getmembers() if os.path.basename(m.name) == "a.txt"][0]
            data = tf.extractfile(member).read().decode()
    assert data == "hello archive"

def _archive_members(archive_path):
    """List the member names stored inside a tar archive."""
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["tar", "-tf", archive_path], capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]

    members = _archive_members(result)
    basenames = sorted(os.path.basename(m) for m in members)
    assert basenames == ["one.txt", "two.txt"]

def test_r8_second_call_archives_its_own_files(tmp_path):
    first_dir = tmp_path / "first"
    second_dir = tmp_path / "second"
    _make_files(str(first_dir), ["a.txt"])
    _make_files(str(second_dir), ["b.txt"])
    first = task_func(os.path.join(str(first_dir), "*.txt"))
    assert sorted(os.path.basename(m) for m in _archive_members(first)) == ["a.txt"]
    second = task_func(os.path.join(str(second_dir), "*.txt"))
    assert os.path.isfile(first)
    assert os.path.isfile(second)
    assert sorted(os.path.basename(m) for m in _archive_members(second)) == ["b.txt"]
    assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(str(first_dir), "a.txt"))
    assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(str(second_dir), "b.txt"))
